commons_description: Visualisation of the use of Huffman coding to encode the message "A_DEAD_DAD_CEDED_A_BAD_BABE_A_BEADED_ABACA_BED" by CMG Lee. The final tree in step 6 is traversed to generate the dictionary in step 7. Step 8 uses it to encode the message.
